description: Office of the Public Service Commission - 6th Amendment for Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Audit Service
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Audit Service, detailing changes to grades, salary scales, cadre, and titles of posts. It also outlines promotion criteria based on seniority. This content falls under public sector administration, specifically addressing service conditions, salary revisions, and promotion procedures for government audit service personnel, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes).
